messages:
lee (Finance): Quick flag - Nimbus Therapeutics got unexpected burst charges on their dedicated commit for April.
tia (Billing): Invoice number?
lee (Finance): INV-2026-04-NIM-2098. Lines show 28.0 + 14.5 GPU-hrs on 2026-04-05 and 2026-04-06.
jon (Accounts): Any infra incidents during that window?
ops-bot: Noted: region outage check - none. Routing change log shows small fallback due to autoscaling policy at 2026-04-06 03:12 UTC.
tia (Billing): Fallback from dedicated->shared for ~45m. Could be provider-initiated.
lee (Finance): Contract clause 5.1 says provider may issue discretionary credits for provider-side failover. Not automatic.
jon (Accounts): What's the dollar amount? Meter rate = $13.00/GPU-hr -> total 42.5 hrs = $552.50.
tia (Billing): My recommendation: offer full waiver as goodwill given short fallback and no customer traffic anomaly. I'll open ticket BILL-14350 and draft credit memo under GL REV-CR-DED-BURST.
lee (Finance): Please tag me for approval.
jon (Accounts): Approve.
tia (Billing): Will post memo and notify customer. Closing loop after accounting entries.
